description: This file defines the 'ModifyAttributeLiveCommand' interface in Java, which provides a live command for modifying an attribute, including accessors for the attribute's JSON pointer and value within the Eclipse Ditto framework.

classes.name: ModifyAttributeLiveCommand
classes.description: An interface representing a live command to modify an attribute, providing accessors for the attribute's JSON pointer and value.

methods.name: getAttributePointer
methods.description: Returns the JSON pointer that identifies the attribute to be modified.

methods.name: getAttributeValue
methods.description: Returns the value to set for the specified attribute.
